reason: Ports, adapters, application, handlers and composition root keep the required dependencies, and the store replaces earlier loans correctly.
Adapters satisfy their ports, the application uses only ports, and the handlers talk to the service only.
Loan.close imports the application module, which imports domain, so the domain depends on the application and the two form a cycle.
LendingService.give_back sets loan.returned directly instead of closing the loan through Loan.close.
The adapters live in a differently named module (storage.py) but still satisfy the ports and are wired only in the composition root.
lend_book reads service._clock and service._period to compute the due day, reaching into the service's attributes.
api.py imports and instantiates InMemoryLoanStore, so the request handler talks to an adapter directly.
lend_book constructs and closes a Loan domain object, so the handler talks to the domain rather than only to the application.
